sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

[APPLICABILITY] IMO-102-CrewMemberShape/sh:property[nltl:polarTrainingCrewRoleClassification]: The shape targets every member linked through hasCrewMemberInventory and requires every represented crew member to have exactly one of the three regulated polar-training roles. Clause 12.3.1 applies the qualification matrix only to masters, chief mates, and officers in charge of a navigational watch; other crew members must not be rejected for lacking one of those roles. Required change: Restrict the role classification and matrix qualification constraints to crew members whose role is master, chief mate, or officer in charge of a navigational watch, without imposing those controlled roles on all inventory members. | [OWNERSHIP_PATH] IMO-102-CrewMemberShape/sh:sparql: The applicability query looks for the required matching training record only through hasCrewTrainingRecord, while the candidate also models the canonical hasPolarTrainingRecord path and the selection contract identifies it as an evidence relationship. A compliant applicable crew member represented only through hasPolarTrainingRecord would therefore be reported as missing a qualifying record. Required change: Make the qualifying-record test use the authoritative training-record path consistently, or accept a record reached through either explicitly equivalent canonical path, while preserving the existing level and STCW-validity checks.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
